column1: # Profiles own n_gpus.  This table supplies the RunPod product for that count;
# rates are per GPU and the queue rate is always derived as n_gpus * rate.
# Keep this separate from row names: a new dose on an existing geometry should
# not need an ops-code change.  SECURE is deliberate (see runpod-spinup rules).
# 2026-08-31: 8xH200 SECURE had ZERO stock at launch (lowestPrice stockStatus
# null at gpuCount=8, while 1/2/4/6 were Low-Medium).  8xH100 keeps the GPU
# COUNT at 8, which is what preserves both house global batches exactly
# micro*accum=32/6.  The 80GB card requires gradient_checkpointing back on
# for the 27B legs.  Revert to H200 when stock returns.
